title: Experts disagree on runtime/templates/stage-agents/claude.md.hbs frontmatter
context:
Chief architect: this states the outcome teams need without forcing version detection into paqad; whether to also state a minimum Claude Code version is the owner question below.

Target: runtime/templates/stage-agents/claude.md.hbs frontmatter
- integration-architect: effort, model and omitClaudeMd depend on newer Claude Code releases; on an older Claude Code an unknown value such as effort: xhigh may be ignored or refuse the agent, so the minimum supported Claude Code version must be stated and tested or the keys omitted when unsupported
- devops-engineer: older Claude Code builds that do not know omitClaudeMd or a given effort level must not fail to load the helper; with omitClaudeMd ignored and no hook the helper falls back as today
